title: Single-cell RNA-seq reveals T cell exhaustion and immune response landscape in osteosarcoma.
authors: Fan, Qizhi; Wang, Yiyan; Cheng, Jun; Pan, Boyu; Zang, Xiaofang; Liu, Renfeng; Deng, Youwen
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单细胞RNA-seq和机器学习构建骨肉瘤T细胞耗竭预后模型，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: T cell exhaustion in the tumor microenvironment has been demonstrated as a substantial contributor to tumor immunosuppression and progression. However, the correlation between T cell exhaustion and osteosarcoma (OS) remains unclear. METHODS: In our present study, single-cell RNA-seq data for OS from the GEO database was analysed to identify CD8+ T cells and discern CD8+ T cell subsets objectively. Subgroup differentiation trajectory was then used to pinpoint genes altered in response to T cell exhaustion. Subsequently, six machine learning algorithms were applied to develop a prognostic model linked with T cell exhaustion. This model was subsequently validated in the TARGETs and Meta cohorts. Finally, we examined disparities in immune cell infiltration, immune checkpoints, immune-related pathways, and the efficacy of immunotherapy between high and low TEX score groups. RESULTS: The findings unveiled differential exhaustion in CD8+ T cells within the OS microenvironment. Three genes related to T cell exhaustion (RAD23A, SAC3D1, PSIP1) were identified and employed to formulate a T cell exhaustion model. This model exhibited robust predictive capabilities for OS prognosis, with patients in the low TEX score group demonstrating a more favorable prognosis, increased immune cell infiltration, and heightened responsiveness to treatment compared to those in the high TEX score group. CONCLUSION: In summary, our research elucidates the role of T cell exhaustion in the immunotherapy and progression of OS, the prognostic model constructed based on T cell exhaustion-related genes holds promise as a potential method for prognostication in the management and treatment of OS patients.
abstract_zh: 背景：肿瘤微环境中T细胞耗竭已被证明是肿瘤免疫抑制和进展的重要因素。然而，T细胞耗竭与骨肉瘤（OS）之间的关联仍不明确。方法：在本研究中，我们分析了来自GEO数据库的OS单细胞RNA-seq数据，以客观识别CD8+ T细胞并区分其亚群。随后，利用亚群分化轨迹来定位响应T细胞耗竭而改变的基因。接着，应用六种机器学习算法构建与T细胞耗竭相关的预后模型，并在TARGETs和Meta队列中验证该模型。最后，我们检查了高、低TEX评分组之间在免疫细胞浸润、免疫检查点、免疫相关通路及免疫治疗疗效方面的差异。结果：研究结果揭示了OS微环境中CD8+ T细胞的差异性耗竭。我们识别出三个与T细胞耗竭相关的基因（RAD23A、SAC3D1、PSIP1），并用于构建T细胞耗竭模型。该模型对OS预后表现出强大的预测能力，低TEX评分组患者相较于高TEX评分组显示出更有利的预后、更高的免疫细胞浸润水平及更强的治疗响应性。结论：总之，我们的研究阐明了T细胞耗竭在OS免疫治疗和进展中的作用，基于T细胞耗竭相关基因构建的预后模型有望成为OS患者管理和治疗中预后评估的潜在方法。
